summary: The `@abstract` tag declares an element as abstract.

summary: The `@access` tag documents the visibility of an element.

summary:

 */

summary: The `@codingStandards` tag names a coding standard for reference.

summary:

point on.

summary:

summary:

examples.title: Excluding a single long line.

summary: The `@copyright` tag documents the copyright information of an element.

summary:
The `@deprecated` tag marks an element as deprecated, optionally since

examples.title: Without a version, just explaining the reason.
examples.code:

 * @deprecated No longer needed now that transport is chosen
 *             automatically.

summary:
The `@example` tag points at an external source that illustrates the use of

examples.code:

 * @example docs/examples/mailer-retry.php 12 8 Configuring a retry

summary:

examples.title: Binding a generic collection's item type to a concrete class.

summary:

summary: The `@final` tag declares that an element must not be overridden or extended.

summary:

summary: The `@global` tag documents a global variable that a function relies on.

summary:

 */

summary: The `@param` tag documents a single argument of a function or method.

examples.title: A plain scalar type.

A shape describing the accepted array structure.
A variadic argument.
A by-reference argument.
A variadic by-reference argument.

summary:
The `@param-closure-this` tag documents the bound "$this" type of closure
passed as an argument.

examples.title: Pinning `$this` for a closure evaluated in the context of a builder.
examples.code:
/**
 * @param Closure(): string $formatter
 * @param-closure-this Builder $formatter
 */
function withFormatter(Closure $formatter): static

examples.title: With a description explaining the binding.
examples.code:
/**
 * @param Closure(int): void $callback
 * @param-closure-this Connection $callback Bound before dispatch so
 *                     the callback can reach the connection's
 *                     protected members.
 */
function onConnect(Closure $callback): void

summary:
The `@param-immediately-invoked-callable` tag marks a callable argument that
is invoked before the function or method returns.

examples.title: A plain marker on a mapping callback.
examples.code:
/**
 * @param callable(int): int $mapper
 * @param-immediately-invoked-callable $mapper
 */
function transform(array $items, callable $mapper): array

examples.title: With a description explaining why it matters here.
examples.code:
/**
 * @param-immediately-invoked-callable $callback Runs before the
 *                                     lock is released, so it can
 *                                     safely mutate the shared
 *                                     buffer.
 */
function withLock(callable $callback): mixed

summary:
The `@param-later-invoked-callable` tag marks a callable argument that is
invoked after the function or method returns.

examples.title: A plain marker on a listener registration.
examples.code:
/**
 * @param callable(Event): void $listener
 * @param-later-invoked-callable $listener
 */

examples.title: With a description explaining when it actually runs.
examples.code:
/**
 * @param-later-invoked-callable $callback Invoked once the response

 *                               this method returns.
